Delhi Protests: Reports of Pellet Injuries and Legal Aid Fund

Reports indicate a fourth individual sustained pellet-like injuries during recent Delhi protests, with the 19-year-old victim potentially losing sight in one eye. The family of another victim stated he was treated "like a terrorist." Separately, Kapil Sibal announced a Rs 1 crore legal aid fund for student protesters. Prime Minister Modi is reportedly addressing student demands following the protests.
